description: Total value locked in DeFi from DefiLlama. For a protocol (its slug, e.g. aave-v3) the current TVL; for a chain (Base, Ethereum...) its TVL with 1-day and 7-day changes. A protocol's history is too large to read here, so it has no change figures. Attribution: Data: DefiLlama. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
